label: quoi FastLeap defaults (F7/M7)
source: quoi Floor7 FastLeap rule pack mapped onto the Savepoint cell matrix
notes: Imported from the quoi planner: every stage/step cell is filled with FIRST (first alive teammate in the leap menu), which is what quoi's FastLeap does when no name/class target is set.
Landmark conds use the seven built-in F7 AABBs as points (crystal_a, crystal_b, yellow_pad, purple_pad, between_pads, middle_platform, i4_spot) and carry the shared 3.0/15.0 error interval.
Stage steps with no built-in coordinate (PREDEV, S1-S4, P5) are left without a landmark cond on purpose - inventing a point there would teleport people to the wrong spot.
Imported landmarks are prefixed quoicnfg- so they never collide with your own captures.
AABBs stay exact and inclusive; the 3-15 interval only ever applies to point/landmark conds.

P1.1.label: crystal group 1
P1.1.desc: quoi crystal leap: standing on either P1 crystal platform beats the plain P1 leap.

P1.2.label: crystal group 2
P1.2.desc: Second crystal wave - the crystal rule still wins over P1 here.
